verdict.rationale: The evidence covers SSO, SCIM provisioning and target-app scoping of SDK client keys. None of it shows Statsig roles, per-flag change permissions, or scoped Console API tokens that limit who can modify which flags. The SCIM text is a generic description of role-based account provisioning, and target apps control which configs a client key can see, not who can edit them. Both are adjacent features, not this capability.

support.subject: As a platform engineer, I can restrict who can change which flags with roles, permissions, and scoped API tokens
